title: G2 Phase 2 closeout: p2-7 defence-suite narrowing + full-suite green with the structural HTTP-free hold guard
reviewer_instruction: 提交后可以进入 p2-7，但 negctl 的上下文 flake 必须作为 p2-7 关闭项处理。建议优先收窄 defense-in-depth mutation 的验证套件或稳定本地 HTTP 测试，不能只靠重跑获得绿色。Phase 2 最终关闭前应证明该控制不会因无关 HTTP 波动产生随机 escape。
notes: 750 = 749 (p2-5 baseline) + 1 new structural guard test_defence_suites_are_http_free. The two defence-in-depth mutations (float layer 2, P1-a(2)) now hold on socket-free file-scoped suites inside the mutation loop; caught=56 / held=2 are hard assertions in test_mutations_are_detected.
